name: China National Building Material Company Limited
summary: China National Building Material Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in building material, new materials, and engineering technical services businesses. The company operates through five segments: Cement, Concrete, New materials, Engineering Technology Services, and Others. It produces and sells cement, concrete, aggregate, and fibreglass, as well as composite and light building materials.
